#!/bin/bash
set -eu
python3 - <<'PYCONTROL'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/skbio/stats/composition/_ancombc.py')
s=p.read_text()
assert s.count('        resp /= np.sum(resp, axis=0, keepdims=True)') == 1
s=s.replace('        resp /= np.sum(resp, axis=0, keepdims=True)','        totals = np.sum(resp, axis=0, keepdims=True)\n        resp[:] = np.divide(resp, totals, out=np.zeros_like(resp), where=totals != 0)',1)
assert s.count('        l1, l2 = numer / denom') == 1
s=s.replace('        l1, l2 = numer / denom','        l1, l2 = np.divide(numer, denom, out=np.zeros_like(numer), where=denom != 0)',1)
p.write_text(s)
